SYNTHETIC PERSONA FOR DEMO - NOT A REAL PERSON.

Aina - Accounts Clerk, Selangor

Summary: Accounts clerk with 9 years in a 40-person wholesale distributor (Contoh Trading Sdn Bhd, fictional). My employer has announced an AI tool that will read supplier invoices and post them to the ledger automatically, and I want to know which of my tasks will change.

Experience:
- Maintain financial records and post daily transactions in AutoCount Accounting.
- Issue sales invoices and credit notes; submit e-invoices through the LHDN MyInvois portal.
- Follow up accounts receivables, send payment reminders and update the debtor ageing report.
- Reconcile bank statements monthly and check accounting records for errors before month-end closing.
- Calculate SST on sales and prepare supporting schedules for the external tax agent.
- Prepare petty cash vouchers and file supporting documents.
- Use spreadsheets software (Excel: VLOOKUP, pivot tables) for monthly sales and collection reports.
- Communicate with customers and suppliers about payment and invoice queries.

Education: Diploma in Accountancy.
Languages: Malay, English.

Faris - Customer Service Officer, Penang

Summary: Customer service officer with 5 years at an online home-appliance retailer (Contoh Online Sdn Bhd, fictional). The company is launching an AI chatbot that will answer order-status and return questions, and my role is being reviewed.

Experience:
- Handle customer complaints by phone, email, WhatsApp and live chat; about 60 cases a day.
- Use customer relationship management software (Zoho Desk) to log, track and close tickets.
- Assist customers with order tracking, delivery issues and warranty claims with courier partners.
- Process refunds and returns according to company policy and escalate difficult cases to the supervisor.
- Maintain relationship with customers through follow-up calls after a complaint is resolved.
- Identify customer's needs and recommend suitable products and accessories.
- Prepare a weekly report on complaint categories for the operations team.

Education: Diploma in Business Management.
Languages: Malay, English, Mandarin (conversational).

Kavitha - Data Entry Clerk, Johor

Summary: Data entry clerk with 6 years at a freight forwarding company (Contoh Logistik Sdn Bhd, fictional). Management plans to introduce AI document capture for delivery orders and customs forms, which covers most of my current work.

Experience:
- Enter shipment, delivery order and customs declaration data into the company database and the warehouse system.
- Verify data against source documents and correct mismatches before daily cut-off.
- Digitise documents with a scanner and optical character recognition software, then file documents in the shared drive.
- Maintain logistics databases of customers, consignees and freight rates.
- Use spreadsheets software to prepare daily shipment summaries for the operations supervisor.
- Keep task records and track backlog during peak season.

Education: SPM; certificate in office administration.
Languages: Tamil, Malay, English.
